shiftLock.slot: Cap near gear selector base on console
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the cap near the gear selector base on the center console. Pry off with a key.
Insert key into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector to Neutral. Replace cap.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
12V battery under the hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally.
FWD: lift from rear — front (drive) wheels roll on ground.
IMPORTANT: Saturn has plastic body panels — do NOT hook or chain to any body panels. Use frame lift points or flatbed.

tow.method: Lift from rear (front FWD wheels roll).
notes: Plastic body panels — no chains on body. Use proper lift points or flatbed.

battery.warning: Plastic panels — no chains on body.

alerts.warning: Saturn plastic body panels — do NOT hook or chain to body panels.
alerts.notes: Discontinued 2007. FWD — rear lift. Unique Saturn plastic body panels — do not hook body.

issues.title: Saturn Plastic Body Panels
issues.detail: Saturn vehicles use polymer plastic body panels. Standard tow chains or hooks on the body will crush or crack the panels. Always use proper lift points (frame/subframe) or load on flatbed with wheel straps.

issues.title: Polymer Plastic Body Panels — No Chains
issues.detail: All 1st gen Saturn SL/SC/SW models have polymer plastic body panels. Tow chains or hooks on the body WILL crack or crush the panels. Always use the subframe or proper lift points. Flatbed with wheel straps is the safest method.

shiftLock.slot: Small cap near selector base on center console
steps: Turn ignition to ON (key to Run position — do not start).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small cap near selector base on center console.
Pry off the plastic cap with your ignition key or a small flathead screwdriver.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under the hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, shift normally.
FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air.
IMPORTANT: plastic body panels — do NOT chain or hook to body panels.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air.
notes: Plastic panels — no chains on body.
